tasks.title: Describe the orchestration architecture
tasks.description: Prepare a concise architecture document for the agent task-control system.
tasks.expected_output: A document that describes task lifecycle, storage, agent contract, acceptance, and Telegram supervision.

acceptance_criteria.text: Task lifecycle states and transitions are described.
Agent input and output JSON contracts are described.

tasks.title: Wire Telegram operator commands
tasks.description: Expose task list, task details, notes, approve, block, and resume commands in Telegram.
tasks.expected_output: Telegram bot commands can alter task status and add notes.

acceptance_criteria.text: The operator can list, inspect, approve, block, resume, and comment on tasks.
